name: bind
description: A number that follows another one: a gauge that follows a stock, the darkness of the screen that follows a wound, the size of a glow that follows a speed, the volume of a sound that follows a distance. Any two numeric fields of any components, on the same entity or on two entities found by their tags.

components.name: Bind
components.description: Every tick, writes into the number target ("postfx.Effects.vignette") of the entity that answers to onto (a tag.Tag; this entity when onto is none) a value that follows the number source of the entity that answers to from (this entity when none). The source is taken between low and high and becomes a share t from 0 to 1 (low may be above high: then the share grows as the source falls), raised to power (1 keeps it straight, 2 makes it grow late and fast); the target becomes out_low + (out_high - out_low) × t. Nothing is written while either entity or field is missing. With absolute the source is taken without its sign: a speed either way.

systems.name: follow
systems.description: Writes the target of every Bind from its source.
